verdict.rationale: Databricks documents its own capability for loading files from cloud object storage: Auto Loader is named as part of its ETL pipelines and described as incrementally processing new data files as they arrive in cloud storage. A standard ingestion connector guide is also documented. However, the evidence never names CSV, JSON, or Parquet support, and never shows a single bulk-load command. missing for 10: explicit CSV/JSON/Parquet format support, a documented single bulk-load command (e.g. a SQL load statement), batch/bulk (vs. incremental-only) loading evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
